test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Tap A can fill a tank in 40 min and Tap B can empty the tank in 60 min. If the taps are opened at the same tirne, then the time taken to fill the tank will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Tap A to fill the tank = 40 min.

Time taken by Tap B to empty the tank = 60 min.

**Formula Used:**

Net part of the tank filled in 1 minute = (Part filled by Tap A in 1 minute) - (Part emptied by Tap B in 1 minute)

Time taken to fill the tank = 1 / (Net part of the tank filled in 1 minute)

**Calculation:**

Part of the tank filled by Tap A in 1 minute = 1 / 40

Part of the tank emptied by Tap B in 1 minute = 1 / 60

Net part of the tank filled in 1 minute = (1 / 40) - (1 / 60)

Net part of the tank filled in 1 minute = (1)/(40) - (1)/(60)

Net part of the tank filled in 1 minute = (3 - 2)/(120)

Net part of the tank filled in 1 minute = (1)/(120)

Time taken to fill the tank = 1 / (1 / 120)

Time taken to fill the tank = 120 min

**The time taken to fill the tank will be 120 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let total capacity of tank = LCM(40, 60) = 120 units

Efficiency of Tap A = 120/40 = 3

Efficiency of Tap B = 120/60 = 2

Total efficiency of (A + B) = 3 - 2 = 1 (Since B is emptied Tap)

Time taken by Tap A and Tap B together = 120/1 = 120 min

The time taken to fill the tank will be 120 min.
